## What it will cover

::: {.mm-stub-outline}
- Multi-objective optimisation and Pareto fronts
- Scoring functions, property predictors and docking in the loop
- Active learning and Bayesian optimisation for experiments
- Protein design concepts
- Pitfalls: reward hacking, synthesisability, leakage into the scorer
- Lab 14: a design loop that optimises solubility and a docking score
:::

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Set up a generate–score–select loop with several objectives.
2. Use active learning to choose the next experiments under a budget.
3. Recognise and guard against the failure modes of optimisation against a learned scorer.

## In the meantime

Part IV assumes Parts I–III. Start with [Chapter 0](../../part-1-foundations/ch00-start-here/index.html) if you are new.
